{{Quote|In just one hour, we will jump into the Sepan sector to quell a long-standing civil war between the peoples of Ripoblus and Dimok.|Harkov|<ref name="TSCE">{{StoryCite|story=The Stele Chronicles (Expanded)|stext=The Stele Chronicles (Expanded)|book=TIE Fighter: The Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>}}
'''Dimok''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sepan system/Legends|Sepan system]],<ref name="CSWE" /> a part of the [[Sepan sector/Legends|Sepan sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|Now we have reports of fighting breaking out on Ripoblus.''"<br />"''Why? Nobody in the Sepan system has any interest in the Confederation. I've had no intelligence&mdash;''"<br />"''They don't need any love for either cause. We've reached the free-for-all stage. What better time than during a civil war to resurrect their dispute with Dimok? Like a cantina brawl. One fight breaks out and everyone suddenly remembers they have a score to settle.|[[Cal Omas]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and [[Cha Niathal]]|<ref name="Sacrifice" />}}
Dimok entered into a [[Sepan Civil War|war]] with the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ripoblus/Legends|Ripoblus]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] prior to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="HNN" /> This war was forcefully [[Sepan campaign|ended]] by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="TF" />

In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], as the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] wore on, the Sepan Civil War broke out once more as old rivalries and tensions escalated across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Sacrifice" />
